description: Resource schema for an Amazon ECS daemon deployment. A daemon deployment orchestrates the progressive rollout of daemon task updates across the container instances managed by a daemon's capacity providers. Deployments are created as a side effect of creating or updating an Amazon ECS daemon, so this is a read-only resource that provides visibility into them.

DaemonDeploymentCapacityProvider.description: Information about a capacity provider during a daemon deployment.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the capacity provider.

RunningInstanceCount.description: The number of instances running daemon tasks on this capacity provider.

DrainingInstanceCount.description: The number of instances being drained on this capacity provider during the deployment.

DaemonDeploymentRevisionDetail.description: Details about a daemon revision during a deployment, including running and draining instance counts per capacity provider.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the daemon revision.

CapacityProviders.description: The capacity providers associated with this daemon revision during the deployment.

TotalRunningInstanceCount.description: The total number of instances running daemon tasks for this revision.

TotalDrainingInstanceCount.description: The total number of instances being drained for this revision during the deployment.

DaemonCircuitBreaker.description: Information about the circuit breaker used to determine when a daemon deployment has failed.

FailureCount.description: The number of times the circuit breaker detected a daemon deployment failure.

Status.description: The circuit breaker status. Amazon ECS is not using the circuit breaker for daemon deployment failures when the status is DISABLED.

Threshold.description: The threshold which determines that the daemon deployment failed.

DaemonDeploymentAlarms.description: The CloudWatch alarms used to determine a daemon deployment failed.

Status.description: The status of the alarms check. Amazon ECS is not using alarms for daemon deployment failures when the status is DISABLED.

AlarmNames.description: The name of the CloudWatch alarms that determine when a daemon deployment failed.

TriggeredAlarmNames.description: One or more CloudWatch alarm names that have been triggered during the daemon deployment.

DaemonAlarmConfiguration.description: The CloudWatch alarm configuration for a daemon. When enabled, CloudWatch alarms determine whether a daemon deployment has failed.

AlarmNames.description: The CloudWatch alarm names to monitor during a daemon deployment.

Enable.description: Determines whether to use the CloudWatch alarm option in the daemon deployment process.

DaemonDeploymentConfiguration.description: Optional deployment parameters that control how a daemon rolls out updates across container instances.

DrainPercent.description: The percentage of container instances to drain simultaneously during a daemon deployment.

BakeTimeInMinutes.description: The amount of time (in minutes) to wait after a successful deployment step before proceeding.

DaemonDeploymentArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the daemon deployment.

ClusterName.description: The name of the cluster that hosts the daemon (the cluster segment of the daemon deployment ARN).

DaemonName.description: The name of the daemon (the daemon segment of the daemon deployment ARN).

DaemonDeploymentId.description: The daemon deployment identifier (the trailing segment of the daemon deployment ARN).

ClusterArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cluster that hosts the daemon.

Status.description: The status of the daemon deployment.

SourceDaemonRevisions.description: The currently deployed daemon revisions that are being replaced.

CreatedAt.description: The time the daemon deployment was created.

StartedAt.description: The time the daemon deployment started.

FinishedAt.description: The time the daemon deployment finished.
